# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made against the latest release and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/codefriendly/omarchy-nightman/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed security problem.

Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. Please avoid including sensitive personal data that is not needed to investigate the report.
